components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Foil gold CTA with ink type; scarce trust metal for primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: #C6A24E; color: #0E2420; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 20px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(14 36 32 / 0.06); transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E4C977; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgb(14 36 32 / 0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C6A24E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Parchment-subtle secondary control with strong ink border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; background: #efe6d4; color: #0E2420; border: 1px solid rgba(14, 36, 32, 0.2); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(14 36 32 / 0.06); transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e8dcc8; border-color: rgba(198, 162, 78, 0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C6A24E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Gold Button
components.description: Transparent control for birr-green/dark bands; parchment type, foil hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; background: transparent; color: #F4EEDC; border: 1px solid rgba(244, 238, 220, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost-gold:hover { border-color: #C6A24E; background: rgba(198, 162, 78, 0.1); } .ds-btn-ghost-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C6A24E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Elevated white field with ink border; foil focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; text-align: left; } .ds-label { display: block; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #0E2420; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid rgba(14, 36, 32, 0.12); border-radius: 8px; padding: 11px 14px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #0E2420; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #888888; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #C6A24E; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #C6A24E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(198, 162, 78, 0.12); }

components.name: Card Surface
components.description: Interactive/record container on parchment — not for hero composition.
components.html:
Verification

Shareable certificate for valid receipts.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 0.5px solid rgba(14, 36, 32, 0.12); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; max-width: 320px; text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(14 36 32 / 0.06); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: Fraunces, ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #0E2420; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; color: rgba(14, 36, 32, 0.65); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgb(14 36 32 / 0.08); }

components.name: Method Stamp
components.description: Square ink stamp with foil border for verification methods.
components.css: .ds-methods { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.4rem; width: 18rem; } .ds-methods li { font-family: Fraunces, ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #F4EEDC; background: #0E2420; padding: 0.55rem 0.4rem; border: 1px solid #C6A24E; border-radius: 0; text-align: center; }

components.name: Session Seal
components.description: Centered foil ring + rounded ink/birr mark for the three-act open title.
components.css: .ds-seal { position: relative; width: 7.5rem; height: 7.5rem; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-seal-ring { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; transform: rotate(-90deg); } .ds-seal-track { fill: none; stroke: rgba(14, 36, 32, 0.12); stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-seal-foil { fill: none; stroke: #C6A24E; stroke-width: 2.25; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 327; stroke-dashoffset: 0; } .ds-seal-mark { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 4.75rem; height: 4.75rem; border-radius: 1rem; background: #1B463A; display: grid; place-items: center; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -8px rgba(14, 36, 32, 0.35); } .ds-seal:hover .ds-seal-mark { background: #0E2420; }

components.name: Foil Progress
components.description: Soft 2px ink track with foil fill for act progress on session open.
components.css: .ds-progress { width: 14rem; height: 2px; background: rgba(14, 36, 32, 0.12); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-bar { display: block; height: 100%; width: 66%; background: #C6A24E; transition: width 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-progress:hover .ds-progress-bar { width: 100%; }

narrative.overview:
Tamagn Tech reads as official Ethiopian payment verification — banknote atmosphere, not a SaaS dashboard. Surfaces sit on warm parchment under a faint gold guilloché field; ink and birr green carry authority; foil gold marks trust, progress, and accents. The brand names itself at hero scale (Tamagn Tech / ታማኝ ቸክ) before any secondary message.

Density stays ceremonial and sparse on promotional and boot surfaces: one composition, one seal, one act of copy, one soft gold progress cue. Product UI (dashboard, forms) reuses the same palette and Fraunces display voice with tighter Inter body copy and restrained white elevated cards — still parchment-rooted, never purple chrome or flat gray app chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed parchment + guilloché atmosphere before chrome
Foil gold as scarce trust metal; birr green for verification voice
Fraunces for brand and act titles; Inter for reading; IBM Plex Mono for amounts/IDs
Seal / receipt / certificate silhouettes as the visual grammar
Hard clip-cuts for act changes; soft foil progress; honor prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The Foil Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Foil gold is metal, not fill paint — progress, rings, borders, and primary CTAs. Do not flood large backgrounds with gold.

rules.name: The Parchment Field Rule
rules.body: Boot and promotional first viewports are full-bleed parchment with guilloché; white cards are for interaction containers, not the hero plane.

rules.name: The Brand-First Type Rule
rules.body: On branded first viewports, the product name outranks the act headline in size and weight; no supporting line may overpower Tamagn Tech / ታማኝ ቸክ.

rules.name: The Bilingual Pair Rule
rules.body: Always show the active locale brand with the alternate script as foil-gold secondary line (English ↔ Amharic).

rules.name: The Ink-Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows take Tamagn ink RGB, never pure black or colored glow stacks.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: The guilloché parchment plane stays flat; elevation belongs to seals, controls, and interactive cards.

rules.name: The No-Pill Stamp Rule
rules.body: Ceremonial method labels are rectangular ink stamps with foil edges, not rounded-full chips.

rules.name: The Seal Geometry Rule
rules.body: Trust identity lives in a rounded square mark inside a circular foil ring — preserve that pairing on boot/title surfaces.

dos: Do open branded boots on full-bleed parchment with guilloché and a centered foil seal before any dashboard chrome.
Do keep foil gold scarce and birr green as the verification title color.
Do pair English and Amharic brand lines on first viewport naming.
Do use hard clip-cuts for act/icon changes and soft width transitions for progress; disable motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do treat cards and white surfaces as interaction containers on parchment, not as the hero.
donts: Don't replace the session gate with a dashboard skeleton, spinner-only void, or generic app splash.
Don't put stats, schedules, promo chips, or floating badges over the open-field hero.
Don't use rounded-full pills for ceremonial method labels.
Don't flood screens with purple gradients, cream-and-terracotta defaults, or glow stacks foreign to this banknote world.
Don't let act copy outsize or outrank the Tamagn brand lockup on title surfaces.
